payload.ddd_rule: Application layer must not import from infrastructure layer. DEFAULT_SYMBOLS and DEFAULT_CNBC_SYMBOLS are configuration constants that belong in the domain layer (domain/models.ts or domain/config.ts) or should be passed by the infrastructure adapter itself.
payload.fix: Move DEFAULT_SYMBOLS and DEFAULT_CNBC_SYMBOLS to domain/models.ts (or a new domain/config.ts), then import them from domain in both the application layer and the infrastructure layer. Alternatively, make the adapters use their own defaults internally and remove the parameters from YahooFxIndicesPort.fetchBatch() and CnbcWorldMarketsPort.fetchBatch() signatures.
payload.severity: non-blocking — tests pass, runtime works correctly. Fix before next feature layered on top of this use-case.
